headline: GPT-5.6 Sol pricing drops 50 percent, reshaping AI economics
body: OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Sol pricing in half, significantly reducing the cost barrier for deploying advanced language models at scale. For healthcare organizations, this price compression directly impacts the economics of clinical documentation automation, chart review systems, and real-time decision support tools built on frontier models. Health systems and health tech vendors evaluating large language model investments should reassess their ROI calculations and architectural decisions around model selection. The pricing shift may accelerate adoption timelines for AI-assisted workflows while putting pressure on vendors whose cost structures assumed higher inference pricing.
